'''Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03''' was a designation of several [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] used by [[Arlaia Zayzen]], a gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. Along with other droids such as [[Medical Unit AZ-01]], [[Combat Unit AZ-02]], [[Assault Unit AZ-A]] and [[Assault Unit AZ-B]], these droids were designated after Zayzen's own initials and assisted her during the fights. In [[3630 BBY]] Zayzen was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]," who defeated her, and while on the brink of death, her mind was downloaded into an [[Isotope-5 droid]] called the "[[Doom Droid]]." With a new, completely robotic body, Zayzen tried to claim her revenge against the Stranger, but was defeated in round nine of the Arena fights along with several Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Several droids designated Advanced Combat Unit AZ-03 appear in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the ninth boss fight of the "Eternal Championship".
